commands.notes: Ctrl+Shift+S is not reliable on Win11 modern Notepad; prefer explicit menu invocation.
Undo granularity is per SetValue, not per character.

ui_map.notes: AutomationId is empty. Use class+role and ancestor fallbacks, never visible text as the primary selector.

workflows.name: read_document_text
pitfalls: Normalize UIA CR output to LF before comparing with disk text.

workflows.name: replace_and_save
pitfalls: Capture an L1 snapshot before replace_text.
Verify the title loses the unsaved marker after save.

workflows.name: new_tab_save_as
pitfalls: Save As is a cross-process Win32 #32770 dialog.
Never silently overwrite an existing target file.

known_pitfalls: Save As is a Shell-owned cross-process dialog, not an in-window WinUI panel.
Closing a tab with unsaved changes opens a three-way dialog: Save, Don't Save, Cancel.
Large files should use the L1 file channel rather than traversing or rendering the UIA text path.
UIA text returns bare CR; canonical comparisons must normalize CRLF and CR to LF in that order.
Opening a file already present in a tab does not reload it from disk.
Startup PID is not the window-owner PID; use window discovery and GetWindowThreadProcessId.
TeachingTip nodes are transient and must be explicitly dismissed or ignored, not waited out.
Save As filename text injection is platform-limited on DirectUI Edit; prefer keyboard input only after foreground validation.

caveats: UIA SetValue replaces the whole document, so Ctrl+Z returns to the previous SetValue state.
Ctrl+Z is not sufficient as the only rollback path; capture an L1 content snapshot before writes.
